name: [RELEASE!] Wukashi
desc:
⭐ BECOME THE STRONGEST SHINOBI NINJA
Join the community server for codes and more. NEXT CODE AT 17k LIKES!
Update 4 RELEASED!

Wukashi is an RPG game based on the anime Naruto. Fight, Rankup, and Progress through your village and become the ultimate Shinobi Ninja. Experience a variety of clans with many gameplay elements to explore.

This game supports Mobile, PC, and Console including controller

💸 Enter the code "starter" in the shop code menu for the following:
- 500 Ryo, 2 Blessed Chests, 100 Experience

🖱️ Controls:
WASD - Movement (Joystick)
WW - Sprint
Q - Dash (L3)
` or ; - Inventory (DPad Right)
M - Skilltree (DPad Up)
T - Switch Kunais
E - Throw Kunai
F - Interact (Button Y / Triangle)
R - Substitute (Dodge) (Button Y / Triangle)
R+Q - Chakra Dash
V - Carry (DPad Left Hold)
G / H (Hold for 3s) - Activate Dojutsu (L/R3 HOLD)
B - Grip (Execute) (DPad Left Hold)
. - Emotes

Premium Players receive improved AFK world reward cooldowns
